1.explanation: This minimal example uses Grommet v2 with a custom FormField theme that draws a gray border around each field. Inside the FormField, a RangeInput is given 100% width by default. However, RangeInput adds extra half-knob width on both ends to accommodate the draggable thumb, causing it to overflow the padded content area of the FormField. Running this code in a create-react-app or CodeSandbox will reproduce the off-center slider and overflow shown in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario: When placing a Grommet RangeInput inside a FormField, the range slider’s track and knob are not centered in the FormField content area. The left edge of the track is flush with the left paddings, but the circular knob is half-outside on the right, and the track continues beyond the gray border of the FormField. In other words, RangeInput uses 100% width plus half the knob’s size as padding on each side, causing overflow.
